community_list_entries.name: PRAGMA: Evaluating Personalized Guidance with Memory Alignment in Lifelong Conversations

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces PRAGMA, a benchmark for personalized guidance in long-term conversations: 100 users, ~4,167 sessions (~160K tokens/user), 400 queries across Event/Traj-Align/Correct types testing evolving preferences and incorrect user assumptions. Code and HF data released.
